findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware and the reworked LoggerMiddleware have no tests
findings.body: The PR moves the contextual-logger enrichment (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) out of the metrics middleware into a new ContextualLoggerMiddleware. It also changes LoggerMiddleware to log through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` and drops the explicit pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID and traceID params. The only test change is renaming a constructor call in the metrics test. Nothing checks that the context ends up carrying the attributes, or that the 'Plugin Request Completed' log still contains the same fields. A regression in the middleware ordering or in `FromContext` would silently drop fields from the data-egress log.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger and discards recorded calls
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`, a new instance that does not share state with the receiver. LoggerMiddleware now calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. A test that injects a `TestLogger` and asserts on `InfoLogs` will see zero calls, because the log goes to a throwaway instance. The fake cannot be used to verify the middleware's output. It should return the receiver, or share the log state.

findings.title: Ordering requirement for the contextual logger middleware was dropped from the docs
findings.body: The old InstrumentationMiddleware doc said it enriches the context with a contextual logger and therefore 'should live at the top of the middleware stack'. That responsibility now lives in ContextualLoggerMiddleware, but its doc comment has no ordering note. Its correctness still depends on running before LoggerMiddleware and any other downstream code that calls `logger.FromContext(ctx)`. A future reorder in `CreateMiddlewares` could silently drop the plugin and request fields from logs.

findings.title: Stale 'instrumentation' naming left after the rename
findings.body: The logger is still created as `log.New("plugin.instrumentation")`, so log output keeps the old 'instrumentation' name even though the middleware concept was renamed to metrics and contextual logger. In `metrics_middleware_test.go` the test function is still called `TestInstrumentationMiddleware`, and the local variable in `NewMetricsMiddleware` is still `imw`. This undercuts the stated goal of naming consistency. If the logger name is kept deliberately for log-query compatibility, say so.
